scope: analytic necessary condition plus actual model/MoveIt boundary evidence; not physical metrology
derivation: sqrt((base_dx-fixture_dx)^2+(base_dy-fixture_dy)^2+fixture_dz^2), opposite signed extrema; yaw and TCP calibration zero in this necessary-condition example
relocation_dependence: This independent-error translation residual is invariant to nominal base relocation; relocation is not measurement or compensation.
measurement_compensation: No supported real sensor, registration or compensation mechanism exists. Experiment truth is not fed into weld replanning.
engineering_decision: A separately versioned measurement/registration experiment would require explicit authorization, declared residual assumptions and new full validation; not silently introduced.
